mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeline for a home addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical timeline for a home addition project can vary significantly based on its size and complexity, generally ranging from several months to over a year. The process includes design, permitting, and construction phases. Permitting, especially in cities like Berkeley or Oakland, can take several weeks to months, depending on local regulations and planning department workload. Hometelligent Inc. advises clients that securing all necessary permits is a critical early step that can influence the overall project duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Home addition timelines vary from months to over a year, depending on complexity, design, permitting, and construction. Permitting in areas like Berkeley can significantly impact duration.
